# **Welcome, here are some projects of mine**

<h2 style="text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid; padding-bottom: 0.35rem; opacity: 0.9;">My sites</h2>

- **[Gerhard](https://gerhard.heterodata.org)** — the history and present of American public finance: taxation, spending, and debt over time.
- **[Shaikh Data](https://shaikh.heterodata.org)** — replications of Anwar Shaikh's *Capitalism* and *Measuring the Wealth of Nations*, with interactive charts, downloads, and full provenance.
- **[Lewis](https://lewis.heterodata.org)** — international economics: balance-of-payments and cross-border value transfers across the world's economies.
- **[Leontief](https://leontief.heterodata.org)** — U.S. input–output accounts; compute and inspect the Leontief inverse across sectors.
- **[Vlad](https://vlad.heterodata.org)** — the official statistics of the Soviet Union and Imperial Russia.
- **[Myrdal](https://myrdal.heterodata.org)** — population as a cause of economic outcomes: the long-run demographic transition.
- **[Race](https://race.heterodata.org)** — race, stratification, and economic disparities in the United States.
- **[Gordon](https://gordon.heterodata.org)** — U.S. employment and inflation on BLS, BEA, and Federal Reserve primary data.
- **[Erwin](https://erwin.heterodata.org)** — military spending as an endogenous feature of capitalism.
- **[FreeNIC](https://freenic.org)** — bank-level U.S. financial-data explorer: failures, FRED series, and active institutions; bulk data free.
- **[Foodberg](https://foodberg.org)** — global food and commodity price explorer.
- **[HMDA Explore](https://hmdaexplore.com)** — a dashboard over Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data on U.S. mortgage lending.
- **[Methodex](https://methodex.fyi)** — a public-domain economic-statistics methodology layer.
- **[JJ Muni](https://jjmuni.com)** — Westchester County sidewalk-coverage web map, tract by tract.
- **[NYC Visualizer](https://nycvisualizer.com)** — live New York City transit map and sidewalk accessibility.

Data downloads across all of these are gathered at [files.heterodata.org](https://files.heterodata.org), and every site is indexed on the hub: [heterodata.org](https://heterodata.org).
